---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement

---

## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Motivation

Why is this feature needed? What problem does it solve?

## Proposed Solution

How would you like this feature to work?

## Alternatives Considered

What alternative solutions or features have you considered?

## Implementation Details (Optional)

If you have thoughts on how this could be implemented:
- Technical approach
- Affected components
- Breaking changes?
- Security implications?

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or examples about the feature request here.

## Compatibility

- [ ] This feature is backwards compatible
- [ ] This feature requires protocol changes
- [ ] This feature affects the security model
- [ ] This feature requires documentation updates
